runtime_encoding: lossless 58-bit cache-line number plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit

neural_action_decoder.request_count: stateless event-keyed Bernoulli inverse-CDF hurdle plus common-quantile Poisson inverse-CDF excess
neural_action_decoder.targets: four-component signed-log direct-delta mixture with deterministic modal-component mean
neural_action_decoder.fill: separate unweighted two-class head with stateless event-keyed categorical inverse-CDF draw

stochastic_decoding: stateless SHA-256 keyed hurdle/count/fill inverse-CDF sampling plus deterministic modal delta component mean
event_key_definition: zero-based role-local decision index plus source-visible cache-line number
captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: canonicalized source-SPP request count, direct target, and fill class as supervision only

lstm.architecture: one compact chronological LSTM plus keyed hurdle/Poisson count, factorized four-component delta mixture, and separate rare-fill head
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT over the complete demand/fill event sequence; hidden/cell values cross chunks and graph history is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; guard is causal warm-up/audit only and evaluation demand callbacks produce replay

eviction_feedback_role: raw chronological source-visible input event only; no private SPP state and no separate eviction prediction target

v16a_diagnosis.normal_l2_fraction: approximately 2 percent in the captured teacher list
v16a_diagnosis.failure: joint deterministic MAP can remove the rare L2 placement even while request count remains high
v16a_diagnosis.v17_change: retrain factorized delta and fill heads; sample learned fill probability with the existing keyed CRN schedule

parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
